concept.concept: Illustrated stack of books with a coffee cup on top and text 'Principal, Teacher, Janitor, and Lunch Lady — All Day Every Day'
concept.audience: Homeschooling parents, predominantly mothers aged 28-45, who share identity humor online
concept.rationale: Homeschool community is passionate, tight-knit, and underserved in POD. Multi-role humor resonates deeply. Back-to-season timing boosts relevance. Strong shareability in Facebook homeschool groups.

A steaming coffee mug sits on top of the stack, rendered in cream with a dark brown handle and three simple steam lines rising above. Single bold serif text arched above reads 'Principal, Teacher, Janitor, and Lunch Lady — All Day Every Day' in black, maximum 5 words per line. All elements centered on a plain pale cream background with 2-inch margins on all sides. High contrast, clean sharp edges, screen-print aesthetic, solid color blocks only, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Design readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
